overview: Ethernet CSMA/CD basics, maximum cable length, switches/routers hops, frame checksum.
coreConcept: Minimum frame size >= 2 x propagation delay x bandwidth (collision detect ke liye).
hinglishExplanation: Max cable length = (frame size / bandwidth) x speed / 2. Ethernet frame me CRC, IP header me checksum. Switch/routers ke beech har hop par naya frame.
formalDefinition: Minimum frame size >= 2 x propagation delay x bandwidth (collision detect ke liye).
importantProperties: Max length d = Tt x v / 2.
Ethernet CRC checksum; IP header checksum.
